title: Tiger Warrior Triptych
description: A three-panel painting depicts the same young Black boy in an orange tiger-striped costume with bells and accessories. In the left panel he stands dynamically with fists raised, in the middle he is captured mid-air performing a flip, and in the right panel he lies on the ground after falling.
prompt: A three-panel vertical painting on dark teal background showing the same young Black boy with spiky dreadlocks wearing a vibrant orange tiger-striped outfit with patches, chains, and bells. Left panel: powerful standing pose with fists clenched. Center panel: mid-air flip with legs extended. Right panel: fallen on the ground. Dramatic lighting, realistic yet painterly style, moody atmosphere.
